title: MineSeed
description: Warm and welcoming community based SMP
body:
# 🌱 Welcome to Mineseed SMP

**Mineseed** is a family-friendly Survival Multiplayer (SMP) where players can make new friends, create cities, build monuments, and explore a thriving community world. Vanilla at heart — with plugins but no mods — Mineseed is the chill, welcoming home you've been looking for.

Whether you're setting up chest shops in a bustling player economy, leveling up skills with **mcMMO**, reeling in rare catches with our enhanced fishing plugin, or showing off custom map art — there's always something to do on Mineseed.

---

## 🌎 What Makes Mineseed Special

- **No overworld resets** — your builds are safe forever
- Multiple SMP worlds including a fresh **1.21.4 world**
- **Keep inventory** — toggle it on or off, your choice
- Free **daily & weekly rewards**, starter loot, and a free starter rank
- Land claiming, public & private warps, and an **auction house**
- **Jobs, quests, pets** with special abilities, marriage, and more
- Participate in a **multi-server minigame platform** with exclusive prizes
- Weekly challenges, build competitions, and Discord giveaways
- **Monthly crates** packed with OP gear, cosmetics, and server-exclusive tools
- Custom chat gradients, name tags, pins, and cosmetics
- Grind your way to **free OP gear** — no pay-to-win required
